scenarios.name: View bulk visibility commands leave the origin plane unchanged in an empty part

scenario_steps.name: The MCAD Software has an empty part with an unlocked copied view active
the YZ origin plane is hidden
the user chooses All Visible from the active view context menu
the YZ origin plane remains hidden
the user chooses Visibility from the YZ origin plane context menu
the YZ origin plane is visible
the user chooses All Hidden from the active view context menu
the YZ origin plane remains visible
Visibility is checked in the plane context menu
